description: Search the accessibility snapshot of the current page for text or a regular expression. Returns matching snapshot nodes with a few lines of context, each under its path from the root, which is cheaper than a full snapshot when you only need to locate an element and its ref.

filename.description: Save results to this file instead of returning them in the response.

regex.description: Regular expression to search for in the page snapshot. Case-sensitive by default; wrap the pattern in slashes to add flags, e.g. "/error/i". Provide either text or regex, not both.

text.description: Plain text to search for in the page snapshot (case-insensitive substring match). Provide either text or regex, not both.

name: browser_find
